entries.target: An infinite range skill that heals 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Heals you and up to 6 allies while placing 1 of 5 random buffs on them. The heal is twice as strong if another player is selected. If an enemy is selected, you will be healed for twice the amount.

entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: A wave of psychic fire engulfs up to 3 foes dealing moderate damage and applies either Mental Burn or Psychic Burn. Mental Burn deals less damage per tick but lasts 12 seconds. Psychic Burn deals more damage per tick but only lasts 6 seconds. They don't stack but you can have both applied on an enemy at once.
